Figure 1:Task-dependent effects of process rewards for Qwen3.5-9B.(a) Independent task schematics, ordered by base-policy horizon. Turns and base
scores are task-type averages, not example-specific results; evaluation metrics
average four repetitions. Fine Cut keeps picture and timing fixed.
(b) Final score differences from outcome-only GRPO.
(c) Fixed-weight process and outcome rewards, and decayed-weight outcome rewards
available from update 21. Faint lines connect recorded observations; thick lines
show centered five-observation means. The aligned strip shows fixed and
cubic-decay weightsλ\lambda. Shading marks the decayed variant’s 20–30 decay window.

Figure 2:Data generation from a film–trailer pair. (a) Two real source clips and their
reference-aligned cuts illustrate shot matching. (b) Each local chunk stays within a story
beat and receives a clip-independent brief. (c) Four tasks share the brief and initialize
from reference states, so errors in sampled outputs cannot propagate between tasks.
Timeline and asset layouts are schematic. D/M/S denote dialogue, music, and production sound.
